control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of pressure energy at P-4102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on P-4102, HX-4120 and TK-4210 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on P-4102, HX-4120 and TK-4210 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. P-4102 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during routine operation while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 29 January 2006 a near hit was recorded on P-4102, HX-4120 and TK-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
